official_definition: When a burst card of the specified color in your hand has its condition fulfilled, you can activate that burst from your hand.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Ultimate Hand] or [Ultimate Hand: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Ultimate Hand]", "give [Ultimate Hand]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
